title: Apple Reports Record Q4 Revenue Beat Driven by Robust Services Expansion
summary: Apple Inc posted fourth-quarter revenue and earnings per share that exceeded Wall Street expectations, bolstered by double-digit growth in cloud and App Store services.

title: Apple Services Revenue Accelerates, Outperforming Hardware Consensus
summary: Analysts cheered Apple's profit margins as services revenue jumped 14% year-over-year, dampening concerns about smartphone upgrade cycles.

title: Apple Unveils Major Enterprise Cloud Expansion in Data Centers
summary: Apple announced new corporate software deployments and expanding enterprise cloud infrastructure investments.
